article_details.title: What is Iris Conversational AI?
article_details.answer_1:
Iris is fine-tuned from EA IQ, prompt and execution engines with a LLM access layer. Iris leverages Open AI / ChatGPT API capabilities. Iris was optimized for dialogue by using Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) and provides valuable insights to EA business units. By analyzing user interactions, sentiment, and preferences, Iris generates real-time data, helping orgs make data-driven decisions and refine their services.
      Iris is not connected to the internet and it can occasionally produce incorrect answers. It is constrained to proprietary data from EA. We'd recommend checking whether responses from the model are accurate or not. If you find an answer is incorrect, please provide that feedback by using the "Thumbs Down" button.
article_details.question_2: Who can view my conversations and how will they be used for training?
article_details.answer_2: As part of our commitment to safe and responsible AI, we review conversations to improve our systems and to ensure the content complies with our policies and safety requirements. Your conversations may be reviewed by our AI trainers to improve our systems.
